requirements.title: Python-type content fully enabled and first-class in Satellite
requirements.one_line_summary: Python (PyPI) content is enabled by default in Satellite and Capsule as a first-class content type, requiring removal of conditional guards so all Python-repo docs apply to Satellite.

requirements.title: Synchronize and consume PyPI content on Satellite
requirements.one_line_summary: Document syncing upstream PyPI repositories (including whole-of-PyPI sync caveats and include/exclude behavior) and configuring hosts to consume Python content from Satellite.

requirements.title: Download policy support for Python repositories
requirements.one_line_summary: Python repositories can now have a download policy set, matching other content types.

requirements.title: Inter-Server Sync (ISS) import/export support for PyPI
requirements.one_line_summary: Python repositories can be exported and imported (including incremental export) using the default ISS format.

requirements.title: Corrected Python repository distribution (Published At) path
requirements.one_line_summary: The Published At URL for Python repositories now shows the /pypi/ distribution path instead of /pulp/content/.

requirements.title: Dedicated Python Packages content type page in the web UI
requirements.one_line_summary: A dedicated Python Packages page is added under Content > Content Types in the web UI navigation, moved out of Other Content Types.
